title: af/worker-package@1 record
description: One digest-pinned Worker package published to the CAS before any Worker of a Task runs. Referenced by ID from `af/task-opened@1`, `af/task-outcome@1`, and every `af/worker-evidence@1` context manifest, so the exact instructions a Worker was given stay recoverable.

digest.description: The package digest the Authority Snapshot's lock pins.

files.description: Every file of the package, by package-relative path, each stored as its own CAS object.
